events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Western Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...
Southwestern Graham County in southeastern Arizona...
East Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...
Eastern Santa Cruz County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 500 PM MST.

* At 250 PM MST, between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen over the
last 3 hours. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in the warned area. Runoff from the rainfall is expected to
continue and area washes are still running, so the Flash Flood
Warning has been extended.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sierra Vista, Safford, Benson, Willcox, Hereford, Thatcher,
Whetstone, Huachuca City, St. David, Tombstone, Sonoita, Dragoon,
Elgin, Pearce-Sunsites, Kartchner Caverns State Park, Roper Lake
State Park, Fort Huachuca, Parker Canyon Lake, Palominas and Pima.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Moson Rd from HWY 90 and Hereford Rd.

events.summary:
* WHAT...Urban areas and small streams flooding along Sabino Creek
caused by excessive rainfall is ongoing

* WHERE...Sabino Creek...

* WHEN...Until 630 PM MST.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings in Sabino Recreational Area are inundated with water and
are not passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 239 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to excessive rainfall. The Sabino Creek gauge is
reporting Sabino Creek peaked at 4.92 feet at 1 PM, which is
above minor flood stage. Another rise in the creek will be
possible over the next few hours due to runoff from previous
rainfall in the Catalinas. Flooding is ongoing in the warned
area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Tanque Verde Wash, Sabino Creek and Ventana Canyon Wash.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sabino Canyon Recreation Area and Seven Falls.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
